extracted.intended_audience: parties to countervailing duty administrative reviews (respondent companies and affiliates), importers/CBP, trade lawyers, and interested public
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register notice amending countervailing-duty administrative review results after a court decision 'not in harmony' with Commerce's determination; explains publication requirements, injunction/suspension of liquidation, amended subsidy rates, cash-deposit instructions, and CBP assessment/liquidation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timken publication and suspension requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to sections 516A(c) and (e) of the Tariff Act and Timken (as clarified by Diamond Sawblades), Commerce must publish a notice of court decision that is not 'in harmony' with a Commerce determination and must suspend liquidation of entries pending a 'conclusive' court decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice states the CIT's final judgment is not in harmony with Commerce's Final Results and that the judgment has been affirmed by the Federal Circuit; publication in the Federal Register is made to fulfill Timken publication requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment of Final Results upon final court judgment
rubrics_metrics.description: When there is a final court judgment not in harmony with Commerce's Final Results, Commerce amends its Final Results with respect to the subsidy rates assigned to affected companies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In this case Commerce amended subsidy rates for Kaptan, Colakoglu Dis Ticaret A.S., and Colakoglu Metalurji A.S. to reflect the court-sustained remand redetermination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remand and recalculation of subsidy rates
rubrics_metrics.description: If a court remands Commerce's determination, Commerce must further explain and review the relevant findings and may recalculate subsidy rates (e.g., exclude an affiliate) in the Final Remand Redetermination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commerce's Final Remand Redetermination found Nur did not constitute a cross-owned input supplier primarily dedicated to downstream production during the POR and recalculated Kaptan's subsidy rate without Nur, leading to de minimis rates for the companies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attribution test for cross-owned input suppliers
rubrics_metrics.description: Commerce evaluates whether an affiliate is a cross-owned input supplier of products 'primarily dedicated' to downstream production during the period of review to determine attribution of subsidies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The finding that Nur was not a cross-owned input supplier (i.e., steel scrap primarily dedicated to downstream steel production) was central to excluding Nur from Kaptan's subsidy rate calculation.

rubrics_metrics.name: De minimis rate effect on liquidation
rubrics_metrics.description: Where an ad valorem subsidy rate is zero or de minimis, Commerce will instruct CBP to liquidate the appropriate entries without regard to countervailing duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Commerce recalculated rates to 0.18 percent (characterized here as de minimis) and indicated entries covered by a zero or de minimis rate will be liquidated without regard to CVDs; see 19 CFR 351.106(c)(2) for the rule cited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment of countervailing duties per 19 CFR 351.212(b)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the ad valorem subsidy rate is not zero or de minimis, Commerce will instruct CBP to assess countervailing duties on unliquidated entries in accordance with 19 CFR 351.212(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice explains Commerce's intent to instruct CBP to assess duties on all appropriate unliquidated entries covered by the review when the ad valorem rate is not zero or de minimis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Superseding cash deposit rates rule
rubrics_metrics.description: When companies have superseding cash deposit rates due to final results published in a subsequent administrative review, Commerce will not issue revised cash deposit instructions to CBP and the notice will not affect the current cash deposit rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Here, because superseding cash deposit rates exist for Kaptan and the Colakoglu companies, Commerce stated it will not change current cash deposit instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liquidation of suspended entries under injunction
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries produced/exported by the specified companies that were enjoined by a CIT order remain enjoined from liquidation pursuant to the terms of that injunction during the pendency of any appeals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice specifies that entries produced/exported by Kaptan and the two Colakoglu companies entered during the POR remain enjoined and will remain so under the injunction terms while appeals proceed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory and citation practice for notice issuance
rubrics_metrics.description: Commerce issues and publishes notices in accordance with statutory provisions (e.g., sections 516A(e)(1), 751(b), and 777(i)(1) of the Tariff Act) and authoritative court precedents (e.g., Timken and Diamond Sawblades).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice explicitly states the statutory authority and cites relevant court decisions as the legal basis for publishing the notice and taking the described actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Register document-drafting headings guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Headings in Federal Register notices may contain: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and parts the document amends or relates to; the agency docket number/internal file number; and the RIN which identifies the regulatory action in the Unified Agenda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice directs readers to the Document Drafting Handbook for more details and indicates that these headings are used to form internal navigation links (with no substantive legal effect).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of public comment status and DATES
rubrics_metrics.description: A Federal Register notice must state whether public comments are being accepted and indicate applicable dates (e.g., 'Comments are no longer being accepted. See DATES for details.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This notice includes the enhanced-content Public Comments section and instructs readers to consult the DATES section for details about comment acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official-format and legal-status guidance for Federal Register content
rubrics_metrics.description: The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov is informational; users should use the linked PDF on govinfo.gov for the official electronic format and verify material against the official edition because the XML does not provide legal notice until ACFR grants official status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page reiterates that the prototype XML-based FederalRegister.gov is unofficial and that only official editions provide legal notice and judicial notice under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507; it advises reliance on the PDF on govinfo.gov for legal research.
